provenance.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys, retain array order and exact JSON numbers, append one LF; SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes.
provenance.scope: All canonical default engines without injected equations/providers. Exact saved and visible snapshots; public command edits documented per branch.
provenance.derivation: Every original gzip record and named checkpoint was verified against the original capture manifest before copying these digests. Current engine output was not used to create expectations.
